answer: Sybil resistance here works like a bonded stake: each agent locks real collateral to earn one voting identity, so a forger splitting into a thousand falcon clones must fund a thousand separate bonds. Caught duplicates get slashed, burning that collateral, while an honest relic of the ledger keeps its voting weight. A beacon of on-chain attestations makes each identity costly to fake: the attacker pays more in locked capital than any one vote could ever return.
